decision_policy.alternative_rule: Scope mismatch yields NOT_COMPARABLE. Otherwise any QUALIFIED_UNAVAILABLE mandatory predicate yields UNAVAILABLE; absent that, any UNKNOWN or STALE yields UNKNOWN; only all QUALIFIED_AVAILABLE predicates yield AVAILABLE.
decision_policy.opportunity_rule: AVAILABLE if at least one in-scope alternative is AVAILABLE; otherwise UNKNOWN if any alternative is UNKNOWN; otherwise NOT_COMPARABLE if any alternative is NOT_COMPARABLE; otherwise UNAVAILABLE.
decision_policy.capacity_rule: A QUALIFIED_AVAILABLE capacity predicate asserts that owner-qualified supply meets case demand. A QUALIFIED_UNAVAILABLE predicate proves it does not. This evaluator does not calculate capacity.
decision_policy.freshness_rule: STALE never qualifies as AVAILABLE. UNKNOWN and STALE do not become UNAVAILABLE absent a current owner-qualified negative fact.
decision_policy.dependency_rule: Failure-domain labels are identifiers, not probabilities or proof of physical independence. UNKNOWN dependency-map completeness blocks independence claims but does not negate a currently qualified usable opportunity.
decision_policy.stable_recovery_rule: Consume the Symtropy owner-native stability state. Emit VERIFIED stable opportunity restoration only when the owner attests VERIFIED at a tick inside an AVAILABLE opportunity interval. Do not infer stability from a brief AVAILABLE interval.
